skill.name: security
skill.description: Guide AI assistants through project security checks, secret hygiene, dependency scans, and OWASP review.
skill.summary: Structured security review guidance for repositories and release readiness.
skill.author: ByronWilliamsCPA

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a Markdown bash code block listing hardcoded security commands. I found no executable code, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The match is the opening of a Markdown bash block in SKILL.md, not Ruby backtick execution or executable code. The listed commands are hardcoded local security checks with no user input interpolation or exfiltration target.

content.value_statement: Security reviews can miss secrets, weak configuration, and dependency risk. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured checks and remediation planning.
actual_capabilities: Lists commands for GPG, SSH, git signing, Bandit, pip-audit, Safety, and Semgrep checks.
Provides pre-commit and pre-release security checklist items.
Highlights OWASP Top 10 areas for manual review.
Supports secret encryption and management planning.
limitations: Does not execute scans by itself.
Requires local tools such as Bandit, Semgrep, Safety, pip-audit, GPG, and SSH.
References workflow files that are not included in this package.
Results depend on project configuration and dependency data.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Security Check
use_cases.description: Review secrets, dependency risk, and common vulnerabilities before code is committed.

use_cases.title: Release Readiness Review
use_cases.description: Check vulnerabilities, signing configuration, and security advisory needs before release.

use_cases.title: Secret Handling Review
use_cases.description: Evaluate key validation, encryption practices, and sensitive data handling.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Security Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the security skill to review my project for secrets, dependency risk, and obvious OWASP issues. Ask before running any command.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Scanner Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the security skill to plan Bandit, pip-audit, Safety, and Semgrep checks for this repository. Summarize findings and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Release Security Signoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the security skill to perform a pre-release security review. Check signing configuration, dependencies, secrets, and open vulnerabilities.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the security skill to triage scan results, map each issue to OWASP categories, and propose prioritized remediation steps.

output_examples.input: Review my repository before a release.
output_examples.output: The review should cover secret scanning, dependency vulnerabilities, signing configuration, and unresolved security advisories.

output: Group findings by severity and affected component.
Identify likely false positives for manual review.
Prioritize fixes that reduce release risk.

output_examples.input: Check whether my project covers OWASP risks.
output_examples.output: The assessment should compare project controls against injection, authentication, access control, XSS, and insecure configuration concerns.

best_practices: Review every command before execution, especially in unfamiliar repositories.
Run security scans in a clean branch with current dependencies.
Pair automated scanner results with manual OWASP review.
anti_patterns: Treating scanner output as complete proof of security.
Running commands against untrusted repositories without reviewing configuration first.
Publishing releases with unresolved high-severity findings.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents security commands and workflows. The assistant should request confirmation before executing local commands.

faq.question: Which tools does it reference?
faq.answer: It references GPG, SSH, git signing configuration, Bandit, pip-audit, Safety, and Semgrep.

faq.question: Can it find every vulnerability?
faq.answer: No. It supports structured review, but complete assurance requires testing, code review, and threat modeling.

faq.question: Is it suitable for release checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pre-release checklist items for vulnerabilities, dependency updates, and security advisories.

faq.question: Does it include scanner configuration files?
faq.answer: No. It references common scanner commands, but this package only contains the main skill instructions.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
